How does cut/bulking work? I'm new to this.

I'm probably not the best person to ask, but when you want to lose fat, you go on a cut. This means you eat less than your TDEE in hopes of losing fat. You will lose some muscle mass as well, but hopefully you can keep that to a minimum if you continue to work out during your cut. When you want to gain muscle mass, you go on a bulk and eat more than your TDEE. A clean bulk is when you eat whole proteins and fats in hopes of gaining mostly muscle mass, so things like nuts, avocados, chicken, turkey, etc. A dirty bulk is when you eat whatever garbage you want (mostly carbs and sugar) but it will have you gain more fat than a clean bulk. Also you will see the term "dirty bulk" or even "perma bulk" used to describe the hamplanets around here, because they always eat garbage all the time. Anyways, after a bulk, whether it's clean or dirty, you will end up with some fat that you don't necessarily want, so then you go back on a cut to get rid of it.
